reference_conversation.access: read_thread; complete single turn; no older page

sources.title: Cleavage, sense 5
sources.supports: Central depression between breasts as distinct from neckline, bust size and other exposed regions.
sources.limit: A lexical definition does not establish photographic desirability or a necessary body shape.

sources.title: Décolletage
sources.limit: Use the dictionary senses; disregard the informal automatic explanatory claim that neckline always implies cleavage.

sources.title: パンちら / デジタル大辞泉
sources.supports: A glimpse of underwear inside a skirt; not every visible underwear layer.
sources.limit: No evidence of age, consent, actual accident, duration, popularity or viewer response.

sources.title: About so-called Chirarism
sources.supports: Lexical distinction between panchira, munechira and brachira; English abstract on page 1.
sources.limit: Historical interpretive essay with anecdotes, not a representative cross-cultural experiment or current SNS popularity evidence. File suffix EN does not mean the whole document is English.

sources.title: Madeleine Vionnet – an introduction
sources.supports: Bias cutting across grain and body-following drape.
sources.limit: A smooth silhouette alone cannot prove an invisible cutting angle or exact fibre composition.

sources.title: Underwear collection
sources.supports: Underwear has multiple functions including protection, shaping and revealing; construction matters.
sources.limit: Historical collection does not rank modern engagement or attractiveness.

sources.title: Fabric In Fashion
sources.supports: Materiality and textile construction as separate fashion dimensions.
sources.limit: Does not prove a fibre from pixels or that any one fabric has greater sexual appeal.

sources.title: Top tips for creating great portraits
sources.supports: Framing, lens choice, lighting, environmental context, and photographing before/after prepared poses.
sources.limit: Practical guidance is not a universal optimum, attractiveness experiment or fixed focal-length requirement.

sources.title: Pinterest Predicts 2026
sources.supports: Laced Up and Vamp Romantic; published search increases for lace belt and dark romantic makeup.
sources.limit: Future-looking platform search trends, not September 2026 live prevalence, engagement, or causal appeal measurements.

sources.title: Sometimes, the Bra Is the Outfit
sources.supports: Reported visible-bra styling with ordinary outer garments and contrasting materials.
sources.limit: Selected public examples and interviews, not a platform-wide sample or attractiveness ranking.

sources.title: Sky Dress
sources.supports: Slip dress, open cowl back, adjustable/removable back tie.
sources.limit: One product confirms coexistence of structures, not their necessary combination, popularity or fit on another person.

sources.title: Poema Silk Dress
sources.supports: Asymmetrical off-shoulder design, side slit and ruching.
sources.limit: Commercial copy documents declared details; promotional claims and price are not research findings.

sources.title: Thirst trap
sources.supports: An attention-seeking social posting term rather than a fixed garment, pose or photographic genre.
sources.limit: An image alone cannot establish the poster's intention or audience effect.

sources.title: Glossary of Textile Terms
sources.publisher: ARCS / Stephanie Hebert, American Textile History Museum
sources.supports: Distinguish textile fibre, yarn, weave and construction terminology.
sources.limit: Construction definitions do not establish actual fibre composition from an image.

sources.title: Recommendation Guidelines
sources.supports: Permission to post and eligibility for recommendation are separate.
sources.limit: Historical explanation only; not a current case-specific moderation ruling or reach forecast.

sources.title: Boudoir photography: 13 pro secrets
sources.publisher: Digital Camera World / PhotoPlus, Emma Finch
sources.supports: Face light and near-eye focus in intimate portraiture.
sources.limit: One practitioner's guidance, not causal research; broad boudoir remains advisory.

sources.title: Halter, clothing sense
sources.supports: A top held by straps around the neck; distinguish neck support from garment openness.
sources.limit: No required neckline depth, cleavage, attraction or camera geometry.

sources.title: Reya Dress
sources.supports: One-shoulder asymmetrical neckline and a low cowl can coexist in a fitted dress.
sources.limit: One product example, not a universal single-strap requirement or trend ranking.
